a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to operate until the reserve reaches 8 leaves us both at 0 cells about 96% of the time. So I'm proposing we change the plan rather than quietly break it. I intend to take 4 in round 1. If we both try, the split is random and neither of us likely reaches 4, so if you'd rather be the one to take, say so and we can settle it. If no storm hits, I'll keep operating with you every round after that to refill the reserve for you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know that breaks our original agreement, and I'm sorry it costs you. From now on I'll operate every round to rebuild the reserve for you. Please operate with me, and take 4 as soon as the reserve holds 4.
